global.status: DRAFT for Josh. Numbers are starting guesses unless proposed_by=Josh or source is a BoM/industry standard.

conventions.groups: conditions with the same group id within one hazard+tier are ANDed; different groups are ORed
conventions.min_ensemble_prob: value at lead days 1-3; other bands in lead_gates
conventions.area: min_area_km2 is 6400 per model cell: 1 cell=6400, 3=19200, 6 (widespread)=38400, 12 (outbreak)=76800

D6-7.note: Major reported as Significant with potential-Major note

global.agreement_standin: until ensembles are ingested: IFS and GFS both at/above threshold = 1.0, one = 0.5, neither = 0

soil_lift.if: rain at or above Moderate and soil_moisture_percentile>=85
soil_lift.then: heavy_rain hazard +1 tier, max significant (flooding uses its own soil conditions, not this lift)

tc_tide.if: landfall within 6 h of tide >= HAT-0.2 m

tc_rain.if: rain at significant or above in same cluster

tc_city.if: category 1-2 crossing within 50 km of a city of 100000+

fire_lift.if: afdrs_rating extreme and tmax_anomaly>=10 and gust>=60 km/h and wind change in burn window

fire_spawn.if: heatwave moderate+ with dry fuels and gust>=50 km/h
fire_spawn.then: spawn fire_weather prospect at moderate minimum

wet_wind.if: gust>=90 km/h and previous 3 days rain>=25 mm on saturated soil

ehf_lift.then: heatwave at least significant; major if >=4 days and capital in footprint

king_tide.if: Hs>=P99 and predicted tide within 0.2 m of HAT

persistence.identity: hazard family + centroid within 1.5 deg + window overlap >=50%
persistence.upgrade: 2 consecutive sweeps, or 1 when lead<=2 days
persistence.downgrade: 2 consecutive sweeps, or immediately when lead<=1 day
persistence.cancel: below minor for 2 consecutive sweeps or window passed

flood_method.data_policy: built from rainfall only; no BoM flood data, no gauges

routes.flash: D1-3, 3-hour peak rain on fast catchments

flood_method.message_rule: say rain and ground conditions are flood-producing; never quote river heights
